X1_entropy_premise.rule: PASS_PROVISIONAL iff >=2 non-iid, non-PRNG proxy models have H_rate <= 0.6*H_marginal AND H_rate <= 0.5*(1-R) at R=0.75. Renyi-1/2 process and marginal rates are reported diagnostics (memory can carry a mean-guesswork surcharge; feasibility of typical guessing is Shannon-governed, tails managed by abandonment).
X1_entropy_premise.status_semantics: PASS here is PROVISIONAL (proxies); terminal X1 requires real traces in data/user_traces/

X2_masking.slope_comment: Fitted log-log growth exponent of the worst positive adversarial masking defect vs n. >=0.95 (linear growth) = FAIL effective Pillar III; <=0.80 = PASS side condition; between = AMBIGUOUS.
X2_masking.mdl_comment: Direct half-redundancy test with the KT-hierarchy exact codelength as the PRIMARY universal code at enumerable n (LZ78's absolute overhead at n<=32 empties the regime; its bins are reported as occupancy evidence). Success >= 0.90 over KT-trials with r = L(z)/d_L,min < 0.5, provided >= 15 such samples.

X3_individual_sequence.kill_rule: worst_gap_kt_per_n strictly INCREASING across all tested n AND worst_gap_lz_per_n strictly increasing => FAIL (structural alarm for Link 2)
X3_individual_sequence.pass_rule: worst_gap_kt_per_n non-increasing from smallest to largest tested n AND <= 0.45 at the largest n
X3_individual_sequence.comment: Exhaustive exact guessing ranks vs the pointwise-min over ALL 2-state genie machines. LZ alone is expected to look poor at tiny n (O(loglog n/log n) redundancy); the KT-hierarchy trend is the decisive early signal.

X4_finite_n_materialization.comment: At >= 2 operating points with oracle BLER in the window: universal BLER <= 2x oracle AND interleaved-baseline BLER >= 3x universal AND universal median queries <= 1e4. Laptop-scale surrogate of the P2 dB gate at n=128, R=0.75.

X5_differentiation.comment: Post-regime-splice, fitted-static BLER must exceed universal BLER by >= 3x, else the universality premium over cheap per-deployment fitting is undemonstrated and the headline pivots to online-adaptive decoding.

verdict_logic.STOP: X3 FAIL (structural), OR (X2 FAIL AND X4 FAIL AND X1 FAIL_PROXY)

verdict_logic.CONTINUE: X2, X3, X4 PASS (X1 provisional acceptable pending real traces)
